reports.title: Q3 2026 Earnings Release and Supplemental Information — page 2

lines: “Following a solid third quarter, we are raising our full year guidance midpoints for Core FFO per share by $0.01 to $1.96, Same Store NOI growth guidance to 1.2%, and wholly owned home sales to $950 million, which supports our continued focus on closing the gap between public and private market values.”
We have raised our full year 2026 guidance, including an increase to the Core FFO per share midpoint by $0.01 to $1.96 as set forth below, in addition to our other underlying assumptions.
(1)Same Store Core Operating Expenses growth guidance assumes a year over year increase in FY 2026 property taxes in a range of 3% to 4%.
